## Goal
Run the first visual test on a freshly set-up Expo app.

## Steps
1. npx sherlo init
2. npx sherlo test

## Happened
The Android build stopped: "SDK location not found. Define a valid SDK location with an ANDROID_HOME environment variable."

## Expected
sherlo test to find the Android SDK that Android Studio installed in ~/Library/Android/sdk.

## Tried
Set ANDROID_HOME in .zshrc and ran npx sherlo test again: the same error.

## Smallest repro
unknown

errorLines: SDK location not found. Define a valid SDK location with an ANDROID_HOME environment variable.
